children: AS Pro Kapital Grupp held webinars in Estonian and English on 9 September 2026 to present the company’s operations, development portfolio, future plans and ongoing public offering of two year bonds with 8.3% annual interest rate.

During the webinars, Andrus Laurits, Managing Director of AS Pro Kapital Grupp, and Ann-Kristin Kuusik, CFO, provided an overview of the company’s financial results, development portfolio and future plans. Together with Silver Kalmus, Head of Debt Securities at AS LHV Pank, they also presented the terms of Pro Kapital’s bond offering and the intended use of the proceeds.
The offering documents and further information are available on Pro Kapital’s website:

The bonds are being offered to the public solely in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. No offer or sale of the bonds is taking place in any jurisdiction where such an offer, invitation or sale would be unlawful without an exemption or qualification provided for by law, or to any person subject to financial sanctions imposed by the competent authorities.
